title: Blood Red Lotus
art_style: High-contrast, chiaroscuro noir; moody lighting with blood-red accents.
short_summary: Ex-cop Jack Malone hunts for the truth behind Eddie's murder in rain-soaked New Harbor, navigating betrayal, jazz clubs, and the city's criminal elite. In the aftermath, Jack finds a fragile peace beneath the neon glow.
world_context: 1952 New Harbor: a rain-drenched, corrupt city of jazz clubs, neon, and shadows. Justice is rumor, trust is lethal.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face with a perpetual five o'clock shadow, limp in left leg, sharp blue eyes, graying dark hair.
quirks: Rubs a silver dollar for luck
characters.typical_attire: Dark trenchcoat, fedora, worn suit, scuffed shoes.
characters.backstory: Ex-cop turned PI after being forced out for refusing a bribe. Haunted by past betrayals and the city’s corruption.
characters.motivations: Driven by guilt, loyalty to the lost, and a stubborn sense of justice.

characters.name: Veronica Steele
characters.physical_traits: Slender, striking emerald eyes, dark wavy hair, expressive hands, dancer’s poise.
characters.typical_attire: Elegant dresses, often green, vintage jewelry, high heels.
characters.backstory: Jazz singer at the Black Lotus, Eddie’s sister, survivor of the city’s rough edges.
characters.motivations: Protect her brother’s memory, escape the city’s grip, find redemption.

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, thick black hair slicked back, heavy brow, scar on right cheek, always wears gloves.
characters.backstory: Mob enforcer, loyal to the highest bidder, haunted by past violence.
characters.motivations: Survival, power, and a twisted sense of loyalty.

characters.name: Eddie Chen
characters.physical_traits: Short, wiry, quick smile, black hair, nervous energy, glasses.
characters.typical_attire: Cheap suit, scuffed shoes, baseball card in pocket.
characters.backstory: Veronica’s younger brother, got in over his head with the wrong people.
characters.motivations: Desire to prove himself, protect his sister, escape poverty.

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Heavyset, thinning blond hair, pockmarked skin, cold gray eyes.
characters.typical_attire: Police captain’s uniform, trenchcoat, battered hat.
characters.backstory: Corrupt police captain, once Jack’s mentor, now in the mob’s pocket.
characters.motivations: Self-preservation, greed, maintaining control over his precinct.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack walks the city’s rain-slicked streets, haunted by memories of violence and loss. Jazz from a basement club stirs bittersweet recollections of Veronica and Eddie. Amid the city’s indifference, Jack finds a fleeting sense of peace.

scenes.scene_description: Jack walks through the city at night, reflecting on the past. The rain and neon lights evoke memories of violence and survival.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in high-contrast noir style with blood-red accents. Establishing shot from above: rain-slicked streets of New Harbor at night, neon signs reflecting in puddles. A lone figure in a dark trenchcoat and fedora (Jack) walks beneath a flickering red neon sign. Streetlights cast long, distorted shadows. The city feels endless, cold, and alive. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack walks alone through the city streets at night.

dialogue.text: The city remembers every scar. Forgiveness is rare.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, harsh red neon, deep shadows

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Jack Malone in trenchcoat and fedora, face shadowed, walking past a rain-streaked shop window. Reflections of neon signs and city lights shimmer in puddles at his feet. His limp is visible in his stride. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack passes a shop window, his reflection merging with the neon-lit rain.

dialogue.text: Every puddle is a mirror to the past.

pages.page_description: Jack alone in the city, rain and neon reflecting his memories.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot of Jack crossing an intersection, red neon from a club sign painting the wet pavement. Cars pass, headlights streaking through the rain. Jack’s silhouette is small against the city’s vastness. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack crosses a neon-lit intersection, dwarfed by the city.
panels.color_palette: deep blues, red neon, white headlight streaks

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Jack’s hand rubbing a silver dollar in his coat pocket, rain droplets clinging to his glove. The coin catches a glint of red neon. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack rubs his lucky silver dollar, lost in thought.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot, low angle: Jack’s silhouette framed against a glowing red neon sign overhead. Raindrops streak down, city lights blur in the background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack pauses beneath the neon, rain falling around him.

pages.page_description: Jack’s memories and the city’s neon blend as he walks.

scenes.scene_description: Jack pauses outside a basement jazz club, jazz music and laughter drifting out. He watches the dancers, lost in memories of Veronica and Eddie.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Establishing shot of a basement jazz club entrance, neon sign glowing red above a narrow stairwell. Rainwater trickles down the steps. Music notes and laughter drift from below. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Exterior of jazz club, neon sign and rain-soaked steps.

dialogue.text: Jazz pulsed from below—life in the city’s cracks.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot through a rain-streaked window: inside the club, dancers swirl in smoky light, jazz band on stage. Red neon washes over the crowd. Jack’s silhouette is visible outside, watching. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack watches dancers through the window, lost in thought.

dialogue.text: He watched, thinking of Veronica, of Eddie’s laughter.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Jack’s face, rain on his brow, neon reflections in his eyes. His expression is softened by memory, lips almost smiling. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack’s face, lost in bittersweet memory.

pages.page_description: Jack outside the jazz club, memories of Veronica and Eddie stirring.

scenes.scene_description: Jack steps away from the club, the city’s indifference pressing in. He walks on, feeling lighter despite the city’s darkness.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Jack stepping away from the club entrance, collar up against the rain, neon fading behind him. The city stretches ahead, empty and vast. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack walks away from the club, shoulders squared.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot from above: Jack’s figure recedes into the rain-slicked street, neon reflections fading. The city looms, but Jack’s stride is lighter, almost hopeful. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack walks into the city night, lighter than before.

dialogue.text: But for once, Jack felt lighter.

pages.page_description: Jack leaves the club behind, walking into the city’s night with a sense of peace.
